description: Turn a technical drawing or a dimensioned sketch into an exact, editable CAD part: a STEP file for CAD programs (Fusion, SolidWorks, FreeCAD, Onshape), an STL for 3D printing and a 3MF for slicers, modelled by TechDraw AI's AI CAD agent, which writes build123d (OpenCascade) code, runs it, measures the result and checks it against the request. The dimensions written on the drawing are used exactly; `notes` carries anything the sheet leaves out. The same AI CAD agent as text_to_cad. Starts a background job (two to eight minutes) and returns a job_id for check_job. Costs 80 credits and requires the Studio plan; refunded if nothing is built.

image.description: The drawing or sketch (JPG, PNG or WebP): a local file path, an http(s) URL, or a data:image URL.

notes.description: What the part is, and any size the drawing leaves out, in mm.

name: drawing_to_3d
title: Model a CAD part from a technical drawing
